svg.title: Partition irreducibility versus coupling
svg.desc: What this figure shows: For the displayed balanced binary family, the product-factorization defect grows linearly with coupling. The plotted object is generated from kappa = TV(P_AB, P_A tensor P_B). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Closed-form synthetic coupling family. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
